walljumpunbound.config.title: WallJump Unbound
walljumpunbound.config.wallJumpEnabled.t: Lets every player cling to walls and wall jump. When off, only players wearing boots with the Wall Jump enchantment can (see the Enchantments tab). Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.wallJumpHeight.to: Upward speed of a wall jump. 0.42 is a normal jump. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.maxWallJumps.tool: Wall jumps allowed in a row before touching the ground again. 72000 is as good as unlimited. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.exhaustionWallJum: Hunger spent per wall jump, in exhaustion points. Sprinting costs about 0.1 per block. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.allowReClinging.t: Cling again to the wall you just jumped off. When off, you must first fall a block below your jump or reach a different wall. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.onFallWallCling.t: Catch a wall while falling faster than 0.8 blocks a tick. When off, a fast fall cannot be stopped by clinging. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.autoRotation.tool: Snap your view to face straight away from the wall when you cling. Skipped on Valkyrien Skies ships, whose walls are rarely on a compass point. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.wallSlideDelay.to: Ticks a cling holds before you start sliding down (20 ticks = 1 second). Hanging from a ledge never slides. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.stopWallSlideDela: Ticks of sliding before your grip gives out and you drop. 72000 is as good as unlimited. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.ledgeGrab.tooltip: Grab the top of a wall that is within arm's reach. A ledge hold never slides, and turning more than 90 degrees away from it lets go. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.minFallDistance.t: Falls up to this many blocks do no damage (vanilla: 3). Catching a wall never hurts below it either. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.clingFallDamage.t: Catching a wall after a long fall hurts: a share of the damage the ground would have done. Armour does not stop it, Feather Falling does. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.clingFallDamageMi: The fall, in blocks, from which catching a wall starts to hurt. Never lower than Min Fall Distance. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.clingFallDamageFr: Share of the ground's fall damage dealt by catching a wall instead. 0.5 is half. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.wallClingPose.too: Draw the climbing pose on clinging players: one arm on the wall, or both hands over a ledge. Client setting.
Rushing wind while falling fast. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.playSlideSound.to: Scrape the wall's own block sound while sliding down it. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.doubleJumpEnabled: Lets every player jump once more in mid-air. When off, only the Double Jump enchantment grants extra jumps. Server setting.
Allow the mid-air jump while falling faster than 0.8 blocks a tick. Server setting.
Extra sprint speed for every player, on top of the Speed Boost enchantment. 0 is off. Server setting.
Extra speed while holding sprint on an elytra, on top of the Speed Boost enchantment. 0 is off. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.stepAssist.toolti: Walk up single-block steps without jumping, even mid-air, and hop over fences. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.blockListMode.too: Disabled: any solid block can be clung to. Blacklist: any block except those listed. Whitelist: only the blocks listed. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.blockList.tooltip: One entry per line: a block id (minecraft:ice), a block tag (#minecraft:logs), a wildcard (minecraft:*_glass) or a regular expression between slashes (/.*_ore/). Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.enableVSCompat.to: Cling to and jump off Valkyrien Skies ship hulls, moving and rotated ones included. Does nothing without Valkyrien Skies. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.shipWallDetection: How far past your hitbox ship walls are felt for, in blocks. Raise it if clinging to tilted hulls feels finicky. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.stickToMovingShip: Carry you along with the ship's movement and rotation while clinging. When off, the ship can sail out from under your grip. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.debugShipCling.to: Write ship cling and wall detection details to the game log, including why a cling was refused. For bug reports. Client setting.
walljumpunbound.config.enableEnchantment: Master switch. When off, none of the mod's enchantments turn up in enchanting tables or trades; items already enchanted keep working. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.wallJumpEnchantme: Boots enchantment that grants wall clinging and jumping to its wearer. Only matters when Wall Jump Enabled is off. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.doubleJumpEnchant: Boots enchantment granting one extra mid-air jump per level, up to level II. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.speedBoostEnchant: Boots and chestplate enchantment that speeds up sprinting and elytra flight. Server setting.
walljumpunbound.config.speedBoostMultipl: How much speed each level of the Speed Boost enchantment adds. Server setting.
